oneLiner: A web-based decision log that records what was decided, why, and when, keeping teams aligned.
problem: Teams lose context and accountability because decisions are scattered across emails, chats, and meeting notes, leading to duplicated work and misaligned actions.
targetUser: Product managers, project leads, and cross-functional teams who need to capture and revisit decisions.
coreFlow: Save and share with the team
Search, filter, and view past decisions

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provides an at-a-glance view of recent decisions, upcoming review dates, and quick access to create a new entry.

screens.name: Decision Detail
screens.purpose: Form for capturing the decision title, description, why it was made, supporting documents, owners, date, and tags.

screens.name: Decision List
screens.purpose: Tabular view of all logged decisions with filtering, sorting, and export capabilities.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Allows team admins to manage members, configure default tags, and set export formats.

outOfScope: Deep integrations with external project‑management tools beyond CSV/JSON export
